Triage: lands in area:ux · domain:ui · Bug · priority:p2 · `pm:queue` · size S; rationale: picking a section tab in the record edit dialog scrolls the dialog itself, pushing the title and tab bar out of view with no way back. Found in the maintainer-ordered HotCRM UI test pass of 2026-11-26 on the released 18.6.0 packages. p2 as filed.

repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Closed as a duplicate of #35092 · 2026-11-26T13:33Z · the premise does not hold on `main`. Read by the `s2-ux-L` area thread: this is #35092 (a section-nav click in a grouped form dialog scrolls the dialog itself away). #35125 fixed it on `main` at 2026-11-18T07:54Z: `FormSectionNav.tsx` `scrollToHeading` now scrolls only the form's own scroll container, pinned by `ui/e2e/form-section-nav-dialog-scroll-35092.spec.ts`, which asserts the `[role=dialog]` scrollTop. The card was measured on the released 18.6.0: `@object-ui/plugin-form@18.6.0` still ships the old element-level `scrollIntoView`, because that cut predates the merge. The fix ships in the next release. Not claimed, no code written.
